name: Chained [2 Player Obby]
desc:
⚠️THIS GAME IS MADE FOR 2 PLAYERS⚠️

Navigate a thrilling obstacle course with a friend. Chained together, you'll need to cooperate to reach the end. But it won't be easy—you're chained, so teamwork is key! 🔑

🎁 You can win a free Chain by liking the game and joining the group 🎁 -> https://www.roblox.com/groups/34327520/1-Day

Controls :

PC 💻 : HOLD "E" TO PULL
MOBILE 📱 : PRESS PULL BUTTON -- STOP PULLING : PRESS PULL BUTTON BACK
CONSOLE 🎮 : HOLD "R2/RT" TO PULL

    local code = codeBox.Text

        outputLabel.Text = "⚠ Please enter some code to execute."
        outputLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 180, 80)
        return
    end
    
    local success, result = pcall(function()
        return loadstring(code)()
    end)
    
    if success then
        outputLabel.Text = "✓ Script executed successfully!"
        outputLabel.TextColor3 = COLORS.accentGreen
    else
        outputLabel.Text = "✗ Error: " .. tostring(result)
        outputLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 90)
    end
end)

local Library = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xHeptc/Kavo-UI-Library/main/source.lua"))()
local Window = Library.CreateLib("OpScripts - Chained", "DarkTheme")
local Tab = Window:NewTab("Main")
local Section = Tab:NewSection("Main")

Section:NewToggle("Spam Mines (OP)", "Spams mines", function(state)
	active = state
	while active do
	for i = 1, 10 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.PlaceMine:FireServer()
		end)
	end
	task.wait()
end
end)
Section:NewButton("To All", "Goes to everyone", function()
	local Players = game:GetService("Players")
	local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
	task.spawn(function()
		while not LocalPlayer.Character or not LocalPlayer.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") do
			task.wait()
		end
		local char = LocalPlayer.Character
		local root = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if player ~= LocalPlayer then
				local targetChar = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
				local targetRoot = targetChar:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
				if targetRoot then
					root.CFrame = targetRoot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
					task.wait(1)
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end)
Section:NewButton("Crash Server (OP)", "Crash server", function()
	for i = 1, 1000 do
		task.spawn(function()
			game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Remotes.PlaceMine:FireServer()

end)
